name: analyzr-integrate
description: Interactive skills that bring customer process landscapes from Signavio, ARIS, Visio & co. into analyzr: /analyzr-integrate:integrate-landscape <export> [--workspace <dir>] inspects an export and takes it over on three paths: it normalizes BPMN 2.0, converts Visio, ARIS AML and other machine-readable formats with an ad-hoc converter the agent writes and the consultant approves before each version runs (in a sandboxed Node, which cannot guarantee a ban on network access), or reads pictures and PDFs into reconstructed models; it keeps model keys stable in the consultant's workspace (rebuilt from analyzr when lost), writes import bundles, previews their import read-only and writes a German report; /analyzr-integrate:interview-guide [<questions file>] turns analyzr's open questions into a German interview guide per contact group, every question with its id so the answers map back, and writes nothing to analyzr. The consultant runs the import, also without an analyzr checkout with the bundled CLI scripts/analyzr.mjs, which takes analyzr's owner key (or an agent token) and sends the owner key only to analyzr on this machine. Needs a shell and Node 24.
